description: Sign this assistant in to a Writavo Site through the browser, so nobody has to create or paste an API key. Returns a link and a short code to show the user; they open the link, sign in or create an account, choose the Site and approve. The approval is picked up in the background and the new key is used by every tool from then on, with no restart. Call login_status every few seconds to see when it lands. If a sign-in is already active it says so and changes nothing; pass force: true to replace it, for example to switch Site. Needs no API key.

force.description: Replace an existing sign-in or a pending request. Only after the user has said they want to switch.

scopes.description: What the new key may do. Defaults to all of: articles:read, articles:write, authors:read, authors:write, billing:read, billing:write, delivery:read, delivery:write, insights:read, integrations:write, logs:read, media:read, media:write, meta:read, org:write, outreach:read, pipeline:config, pipeline:read, pipeline:run, plan:write, prompts:write, roles:write, seo:read, seo:write, site:read, site:write, taxonomy:read, taxonomy:write, team:read, team:write. Credential and webhook management are never available here.

name: login
title: Sign in through the browser
